instruction: Add all the songs from Astrid Nightshade that have been played over 980 times to my Spotify player queue.
notes: Single-app (spotify) task. Username comes from supervisor.show_profile (email), password from supervisor.show_account_passwords. search_artists resolves the artist id (knowledge predicate known-id), search_songs with artist_id and min_play_count makes the qualifying song ids known (songs-searched), and add_to_queue queues each qualifying song. The object astrid-high-play-song is a representative of the set of qualifying songs: at execution time the spotify-add-to-queue step is repeated once for every song returned by search_songs whose play_count is strictly greater than 980 (the API filter min_play_count is inclusive, so results equal to 980 are dropped). supervisor-complete-task carries the song as a non-API record parameter so its precondition enforces the goal (queued) before completion; the task asks no question, so complete_task is called without an answer. The static fact (qualifies song artist threshold) encodes world structure, not agent knowledge; nothing is logged in or known initially.
